_readme: Approved announcements shown on events/. Append one object per item AFTER approval. Fields: id (unique slug), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD, Mountain Time), time (optional, free text e.g. '6:30 PM'), endDate (optional YYYY-MM-DD for multi-day items; hides after this day instead of date), place, details (one short line), flyer (optional, path relative to events/, e.g. 'flyers/2026-11-20-slug.jpg', max 1200px wide), link (optional URL), linkLabel (optional, default 'More info'). Items hide automatically once their date (or endDate) is before today in America/Denver. SAMPLE entries below are preview-only: remove before going live.
